d.ko: BOXROOM allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.
d.en: BOXROOM allows you to design, define and decorate a room - a sanctuary - for your Steam library, and then revel in the organisation of your game collection.
d.zh: 《游戏盒收藏室》让你有机会为自己的Steam游戏库设计、规划、布置一个专属的空间，然后尽情感受收纳的井然有序，品味其中的成就感与充实。
